The Kasm AlmaLinux 9 Workspace requires libseccomp => 2.5.3 to run.

If you still want to run AlmaLinux 9 but do not have the minimum required libseccomp version, it can be run in an unsecure manner by adding: {"security_opt":["seccomp=unconfined"]} to the Docker Run Config Override (JSON) setting above.

workspaces.notes:
The Kasm Kali Linux Workspace requires libseccomp => 2.5.3 to run.

This can be checked by running runc --version

If you still want to run Kali Linux but do not have the minimum required libseccomp version, it can be run in an unsecure manner by adding: {"security_opt":["seccomp=unconfined"]} to the Docker Run Config Override (JSON) setting above.

NOTE: This will run the Workspace without the docker seccomp sandbox and will significantly reduce the amount of protection that Kasm Workspaces can provide.

Please see the following documentation for configuring the image to run as root, utilize sudo, or other custom privileges.

workspaces.description: redroid (Remote-Android) is a multi-arch, GPU enabled, Android in Cloud solution.
workspaces.name: kasmweb/redroid:1.15.0
workspaces.notes:
The Redroid Workspace is experimental.
It leverages Kasm's DinD (Docker in Docker) image, and automates utilizing Redroid and scrcpy projects.

This image requires the "binder_linux" host level kernel modules installed and enabled.  See [Redroid Docs](https://github.com/remote-android/redroid-doc?tab=readme-ov-file#getting-started) for more details.

## Example for installing binder_linux on Ubuntu 22.04 LTS host
```
sudo apt install linux-modules-extra-`uname -r`
sudo modprobe binder_linux devices="binder,hwbinder,vndbinder"
```

The left ALT key is mapped as the hotkey for scrcpy

- Alt+R - rotate the android device
- Alt+F - fullscreen the android device
- Alt+Up/Alt+Down - Increase the volume of the device

See [scrcpy docs](https://github.com/Genymobile/scrcpy) for more details.

Various functionality within the image can be adjust by altering the environment variables as described in the [Dockerhub Registry](https://hub.docker.com/r/kasmweb/redroid)

If you still want to run Ubuntu Jammy but do not have the minimum required libseccomp version, it can be run in an unsecure manner by adding: {"security_opt":["seccomp=unconfined"]} to the Docker Run Config Override (JSON) setting above.

NOTE: This will run the Workspace without the docker seccomp sandbox and will significantly reduce the amount of protection that Kasm Workspaces can provide.
